notes.title: Hop Step Sing live broadcast (June 19th)
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32526477/ad6711049889153c301937186a90e8005cebc2ed.jpg[/img]
The official Hop Step Sing Twitter just announced they will be broadcasting live for the first time in a while with a big announcement about the group's future?!
Even we don't know what it is, but if you want to watch, the link is below along with the official Twitter.

Date & time
19th June (Wed) 20:00 (Japan time)
Place: https://live.nicovideo.jp/gate/lv320523889
NB the broadcast will be in Japanese only!

If you want to send any messages of support, please use this hashtag: #ほぷなま and their official Twitter is here: https://twitter.com/hopstepsing
